description: 과학기술정보통신부 국립전파연구원_휴대폰 SAR정보 DB [telecommunications] is a dataset listed in Public Data Portal of Korea (data.go.kr), an open data portal, published or maintained by 과학기술정보통신부 국립전파연구원. 일상생활에서 휴대전화와 같은 휴대용 송신 무선설비를 이용할 때 우리 눈에는 보이지 않지만 전자파가 발생합니다. 이러한 전자파는 사람이나 동물의 몸에 흡수가 될 수 있는데 이를 숫자로 표현한 값을 전자파흡수율(SAR)이라 하며 이에 대한 국가별 전자파 흡수율 기준 입니다. SAR은 인체가 전자파를 흡수하는... Coverage: South Korea. The portal files it under the publisher 과학기술정보통신부 국립전파연구원. Its tags are 무선설비, 전자파, 흡수율, 등급제, 휴대전화. It offers 1 resource(s) in csv. The portal shows 2025-06-10 as the last metadata change. The title and description are in Korean; the topic words in square brackets are the cataloguer's translation of the title. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is not stated on the portal listing (dataset page not read). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support telecommunication coverage and network deployment studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-kr-dgk-portal.
